title: docs(skills): the retirement playbook states the measured order between a key removal and its skills card

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:退役手册的「已发布 skills」一项改写为按门禁实测的先后次序(含普通表行受 liveness Leg 1 管、标记示例与穷举段并存时拆两张卡);§5 那段散文删去(规则在 AGENTS.md 与 §4 有家),§6 一条与 §1 重复的事实删去以付行。
- 为什么改:裁决 B 让 skills 改动另立卡,但手册没说两张卡谁先落;次序错了,其中一张 PR 会红在门禁上。
- 风险与回滚:只动内部规则文本,不发布任何包;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` 第 286–294 行(先后次序那一段)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`,预期该文件 337 行、上限 337、余量 0。
- 需要你做的:无,`.claude/**` 属 Tier S,席位凭契约复核落地。

## What changes

One file, net zero lines (+11 / -11 against merge base `2359ceadc`).

**The published-skills checklist item** now states the order the gates force between a key removal and the separate `domain:skills` card that stops teaching the key. Each gate below was read on `origin/main` at `216674301`, not run against a removal:

| What the skill does with the key | Gate (code read) | What reds, and when | Order |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| A marked TS example (`os:check`) writes it | `check:skill-examples`: tsc over marked blocks against the built spec; a `retiredKey()` tombstone is typed `never`, so TS2322 | the retirement PR | skills card first (it deletes the key or changes the value), retirement card `Blocked-by:` it |
| A marked YAML fence (`os:check-yaml`) writes it | `check:yaml-examples`: live-schema `safeParse` of each marked fence; the tombstone refuses | the retirement PR | same as above |
| A section registered exhaustive over a schema symbol lists it | `check:skill-identifier-liveness` Leg 2: a live member with no row is `[leg2-missing-row]` | the skills PR, if it lands first | retirement first, skills card `Blocked-by:` it |
| The value is retired with `enumWithRetiredValues` and its enum is bound | same gate: the declaration stops being a shape `membersOf` reads, so `[stale-binding]` | the retirement PR | the retirement PR re-points the binding as the message prescribes |
| The `defineStack()` top-level key enumeration lists it | `check:skill-top-level-keys`: symmetric difference against `COMPOSE_KEY_DISPOSITIONS` | the skills PR (`[missing]`) | a tombstoned top-level key stays declared, so deleting it needs a maintainer-only `NOT_AUTHORED` row: `needs_decision` |
| `references/_index.md` drifts | `check:skill-refs`: a generator in `--check` mode | the retirement PR | regenerated in the retirement PR |
| A plain table row whose first cell is one backticked identifier (negative-header columns excepted) cites it | `check:skill-identifier-liveness` Leg 1: zero word-token hits for any segment in `.ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs/.json` under `packages/**` and `ui/packages/**` (dist skipped) is `[leg1-phantom]` | the retirement PR, on a no-tombstone removal that leaves the name nowhere else; a tombstone or an absence pin keeps it green | skills card first in the red case; otherwise grep, after the retirement |
| One value sits in a marked example and in a registered section | both rows above | both | two skills cards, one before and one after the retirement; one combined card is a `Blocked-by:` cycle |
| Unmarked blocks, rows Leg 1 does not red | no gate | nothing | grep, after the retirement |

**§5's closing sentence is deleted.** Both of its rules already have a home: the ban on hand-matching `check:*` names is AGENTS.md "Don't match by hand", and running the source audits `check:generated` skips as a whole set is §4's checklist item. **§6's truncated-grep bullet** drops "`examples/` has three `template: true`", which §1 already states; re-wrapped without that cut the bullet still needs three lines, so the cut, not the wrap, pays the line.

Every added line is at most 120 bytes (120, 116, 115, 119, 120, 117, 119, 119, 120, 116, 84) and none cites an issue number.

## Tests

No code changed, so there are no tests to run. Each claim in the item was checked against gate source on `origin/main`: `packages/spec/scripts/check-skill-examples.ts`, `packages/spec/scripts/check-yaml-examples.ts`, `scripts/check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs` (`run`, `bindingMembers`, `literalMembersOf`, `unknownSymbolMessage`), `scripts/check-skill-top-level-keys.mjs` (`judge`, `NOT_AUTHORED`), `packages/spec/scripts/build-skill-references.ts`, `packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key.ts`. `lint.yml` runs all of these on every PR with no paths filter. Leg 1 was read in `scripts/check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs` on `2359ceadc`: `IMPL_ROOTS`, `IMPL_EXTENSIONS`, `SKIP_DIRS`, `buildIndex`, `extractCitations`, `citationOf`, `NEGATIVE_HEADERS`, `deadSegments`, `phantomMessage`.

## Acceptance notes

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md` says the skills sub-card is `Blocked-by:` the product card. For marked examples the gates force the opposite order, and this item now says so. The skills card that lands first only deletes the key or changes the value, so it still records nothing that has not landed. The lane line is outside this card's file surface. filed #32549
- The one Leg 2 binding with a `minus` set (`generate-kinds`, a CLI generator, not a spec property) reds in both orders. Deleting the row first gives `[leg2-missing-row]`; retiring the kind while the row still names it gives `[leg2-retired-row]`. That is outside this playbook's subject. filed #32550
- The card and the claim say Tier H. `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on this path answers Tier S (`claude-tree`).
- `check:pm-skill-ratchet` reports this file's `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pin at 326 against a measured 324, so headroom is 2. This PR changes no table row and does not cause it, and the pin is outside the file surface.

## Verification
